entities.summary: Phan Chu Trinh, a notable figure in the history of Vietnam, associated with French Indochina (1887–1930). Preceded by Colonial Exploitation and Nationalist Awakening. Their legacy influenced Ho Chi Minh founds the Indochinese Communist Party and Yen Bai mutiny — VNQDD-led uprising brutally suppressed.
